To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed and tested a novel method to map in vivo the influx and out-flux transcapillary transfer rate constants of contrast agent in tumors and have applied it to a mouse model of invasive breast tumors.

the transcapillary influx and outflux transfer rates were quantitatively measured in orthotopic breast tumors, with the outflow transfer rate exceeding the inflow transfer rate, suggesting that the interstitial pressure is higher than the intravascular pressure.
we have shown that the transcapillary transport rates can be measured in vivo at the pixel resolution in orthotopicaly inoculated invasive breast cancer tumors.

the development of high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging for the in vivo mapping of the spatial and temporal variations of the transcapiliary transfer rates.
developing methods for noninvasively quantifying the transcapillary fluid transport in vivo in tumors, which could be applied to predict the efficacy of drug delivery.
the development of a new imaging method for the in vivo mapping of the disparities in transcapillary transport in tumors.

the high-resolution dynamic contrast enhancement imaging technique is a promising method to study the transcapillary transport in vivo and to assess the efficacy of drug delivery in tumors.
the high-resolution MRI method described herein can be applied to study the transcapillary transport of drugs in vivo.

the high-resolution dynamic contrast enhancement imaging of disparities in transcapillary flux in orthotopicaly inoculated invasive breast tumor can be used to predict the efficacy of the delivery of blood borne anticancer drugs.

the high-resolution dynamic contrast enhanced MRI can be used to map the transcapillary exchange fluxes, which can help to predict the efficacy of blood-borne drugs.

the transcapillary exchange is a dynamic process that can be monitored in vivo in tumors using high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging.
